purpose: Independent observation F010 reconstruction input; it is not a Citlali product and cannot be inferred from final FITS planes.
record_order: exact scan-major-detector-major-sample-minor-cartesian-v1 order bound by the matching raw-input manifest; every authorized tuple appears once

raw_manifest_membership_authority.scan_order: ordered records with contiguous zero-based scan_index, unique immutable identity, and positive sample_count
raw_manifest_membership_authority.detector_order: ordered records with contiguous zero-based detector_index, unique detector_uid, and declared network
raw_manifest_membership_authority.ledger_tuple_gate: the ledger tuples must equal the complete Cartesian sequence for each scan, then detector, then sample index 0..sample_count-1; no omitted, fabricated, repeated, or reordered term is accepted
raw_manifest_membership_authority.cross_array_scan_gate: the three array memberships for one observation must declare an identical scan order

required_scalar_members.raw_input_manifest_sha256: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters binding the ledger to the exact point or science manifest
required_scalar_members.producer_identity: nonempty <=256-character frozen program/source SHA and invocation identity
required_scalar_members.array: exact string a1100, a1400, or a2000
required_scalar_members.sample_rate_hz_numeric: binary64-compatible decimal string or scalar for the exact positive d_fsmp
required_scalar_members.sample_rate_hz_hex: C99/Python hexadecimal rendering of the same binary64 d_fsmp

required_array_members.row: int64[n_terms]; rounded map row when projection is finite, including an out-of-range value for finite out-of-bounds projections; -1 may represent nonfinite projection
required_array_members.col: int64[n_terms]; rounded map column under the same rule as row
required_array_members.detector_index: int64[n_terms] in the frozen detector ordering
required_array_members.sample_index: int64[n_terms] in the frozen per-scan sample ordering
required_array_members.scan_index: int64[n_terms], zero-based index into the frozen ordered scan manifest and realization_signs
required_array_members.geometric_in_bounds: uint8[n_terms], binary finite in-bounds projection before detector/sample eligibility
required_array_members.upstream_eligible: uint8[n_terms], binary detector/APT flag clear, sample flag clear, and geometric_in_bounds
required_array_members.coefficient: float64[n_terms] at the ordinary primitive contribution stage
required_array_members.sample_signal: float64[n_terms] at the ordinary primitive contribution stage
required_array_members.sample_kernel: float64[n_terms] for the campaign-required kernel companion
required_array_members.realization_signs: int8[n_scans,64], each value exactly -1 or +1, one scan sign shared across detectors because randomize_dets=false

reconstruction_rule.geometric_hits: add one for every geometric_in_bounds term before detector/sample eligibility
reconstruction_rule.explicit_invalid: flagged detector/sample or nonpositive finite coefficient does not contribute; geometric and eligible facts retain their defined earlier-stage meanings
reconstruction_rule.valid_nonfinite: an eligible nonfinite coefficient, or a positive-coefficient nonfinite signal/kernel/realization, is a fail-closed execution inconsistency for a successful campaign
reconstruction_rule.retained_exposure: add sample_interval_s for contributing terms, then zero outside normalization support
reconstruction_rule.noise: add realization_signs[scan_index,r] * coefficient * sample_signal for every contributing term

minimum_raw_manifest_binding: exact ordered observation, scan, detector, array, and network membership
raw, KIDs, APT, calibration, pointing-support, FWHM, and target-center source paths with SHA-256
exact sample rate and projection/map-index authority
producer source SHA, executable/module identities, and complete invocation

external_parallel_limit.reason: The exact 2*gamma_n*sum(abs(per-scan-plane)) lane requires run-produced pre-normalization binary64 per-scan accumulator planes and final commit order. The independent pre-run ledger reconstructs F010 and realization products but normalized signal_I times weight_I is not that authority.
external_parallel_limit.unity_gate: Seq/OpenMP inventory, support, WCS, and every persisted numeric product are still compared under the registered atol=2e-8 and rtol=1e-10 bounds.
external_parallel_limit.local_authority: The candidate local F011 truth suite remains the exact scan-farm policy gate.

fail_closed: A missing member, noncanonical identity, unordered or repeated term, sample-rate mismatch, nonfinite successful-run inconsistency, or digest mismatch is an evidence gap. Published F010 planes must never be substituted as their own independent reconstruction source.
